clips.title: The story
paras: King of the Foulweald is a Horde military strike commissioned by Karang Amakkar at Zoram'gar Outpost. Seeking to subdue the corrupted Foulweald furbolgs southeast of Astranaar, Horde champions plant a war banner directly atop the tribe's sacred totem mound, provoking and executing their chieftain, Chief Murgut.

While the night elves struggle to contain Ashenvale's corrupted native tribes, the Horde approaches the threat with calculated aggression. Karang Amakkar at Zoram'gar Outpost recognizes that while the Foulweald tribe may not rival the vast numbers of the northern Thistlefur, their unchecked ferocity represents a lurking danger along the southern road. Rather than wait for ambushes on Horde patrols, Karang orders a preemptive demonstration of martial dominance to break the tribe's will.

The strike targets Greenpaw Village, situated northeast of Mystral Lake. Karang crafts a tribal war banner intended to be driven directly into the center of the Foulweald totem mound—an unforgivable insult to the tribe's ancestral spirits and pride. Furbolg defenders rush the mound in desperation to tear down the offending standard, compelling Chief Murgut to emerge and defend his honor in open combat. Claiming Murgut's personal totem shatters their leadership and establishes Horde supremacy in the area.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, another tribe of Furbolgs, the Foulweald, live southeast of Astranaar. They are not as many as the Thistlefur, but their ferocity poses a future threat. With a show of force, we can remove that threat.

Take this banner, go to the Foulweald village and place it on their totem mound. They will try to destroy the banner, but hold your ground until their chief, Murgut, appears to save face for the tribe. Bring me the totem he carries.
Gather your allies, friend. This is no task for a single adventurer.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you defeat Chief Murgut, friend? Did you retrieve his Foulweald Totem?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Good work, friend. Issuing that challenge to the Foulwealds and defeating their leader sends them a strong message:
The Horde is not to be trifled with.
I don't believe that tribe will giving us much trouble for a long time.
